status_detail: Neuro.io announced a $100 million multi-phase innovation campus in Terrebonne Parish. Official LED/TEDA releases say work was expected to start in fall 2025, continue through 2035, and later phases are anticipated to develop AI data centers, engineering clusters, and cognitive labs.
notes: Project is broader than a conventional data center: initial scope includes advanced manufacturing, digital therapeutics training, AI/brain technology, and later phases with AI data centers. LED offered FastStart plus a $10M performance-based infrastructure/facility-improvement grant; Industrial Tax Exemption and Quality Jobs participation expected.

aliases: NovaSpark Houma Atmospheric Hydrogen Generator Facility
status_detail: NovaSpark Energy announced a $30 million Houma manufacturing facility to scale atmospheric hydrogen generator production; official LED release says the Houma facility will support critical infrastructure uses including backup power for data centers, with operations expected in 2027.
notes: Supporting/enabling infrastructure only, not a data center campus or operator site. Included for broad coverage because official sources explicitly identify data-center backup power as an intended market for the Houma facility.
